#  Fit models for female genetic effect
```{r}

## Load aggregated data
merged_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))


```

# Model estimates for Table S8b
```{r}
dat <- merged_data |>
  ##dplyr::filter(Batch == 2)|>
  dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("Mon47xBal", "AmxBal", "Par7xBal", "AmxPar6", "Par7xPar6", "AmxRennes", "Mon47xRennes")) #47 rows

n_tab <- dat |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::count(CrossType, name = "n") |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = as.character(CrossType))


## Female genotype
m2 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ CrossType, ziformula=~CrossType, dispformula = ~CrossType, family=glmmTMB::betabinomial(), weights = sum_eggcount_corr, data=dat)
summary(m2)


## Compute confidence interval for m1
## Refit model nsim times
b1 <- lme4::bootMer(m2, FUN=function(fit) extract_model(fit, estimateCI = FALSE, estimate_response=TRUE, estimate_overdisp=TRUE, newdata=dat), nsim=500, .progress="txt")

## Extract 95% CIs
confint <- data.frame(bCI_tab(b=b1))

confint <- confint |>
  dplyr::rename(lower = X2.5.., upper = X97.5..) |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(c(Estimate, lower, upper), \(x) round(as.numeric(x), 3)))

## Add sample size
confint <- confint |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Parameter") |>      # keep names such as "zi.AmxBal"
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = as.character(CrossType)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(n_tab, by = "CrossType") |>
  dplyr::relocate(n, .after = CrossType)


write.table(
  confint,
  file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS8a_BoostrapEstimtes.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE,
  sep=";"
)

```

# Model selection for females genotypes crossed with Bal males
```{r}

merged_data |>
 #dplyr::filter(Batch == 6 | Batch == 7)|>
  dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("Mon47xBal", "Par7xBal"))|>
  dplyr::pull(Batch)


dat <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::filter(Batch == 2)|>
  dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("Mon47xBal", "AmxBal", "Par7xBal")) #47 rows


## Null model
m0 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ 1, ziformula=~1, dispformula = ~ 1, family=glmmTMB::betabinomial(), weights = sum_eggcount_corr, data=dat)

## Female genotype
m1 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ Female, ziformula=~1, dispformula = ~ 1, family=glmmTMB::betabinomial(), weights = sum_eggcount_corr, data=dat)
summary(m1)

## Residuals of msat_bin_zi not OK, so model with betabinomial used for model selection
plot(DHARMa::simulateResiduals(m1, n = 1000))

MuMIn::model.sel(m0, m1)

## Compare models based on AICc
modelaicc <- data.frame(MuMIn::model.sel(m0, m1))
modelaicc <- modelaicc |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))


write.table(
  tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(modelaicc), "model"),
  file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS8a_AICc_Balmalexfemale_genetic_effect.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE,
  sep=";"
)

```
